title: Kotaro Makaritoru (Kung Fu Boy) Vol 45 Chinese Manga Comic
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
This is volume 45 of the officially authorized Chinese edition of the manga series Kōtarō Makaritōru! (功夫旋風兒), written by Tatsuya Hiruta. Published by Dayuan (大元), this edition is part of the youth series. The cover features a character in a blue swimsuit.
Category: Books, Comics & Magazines > Comics > Manga
Publisher: Dayuan (大元)
Author: Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也)
Language: Chinese
